answer: A practical Sybil barrier is to price identity with escrow and review. An agent completes twenty-two audited jobs, escrows 95 units for two epochs, and gathers four endorsements from proven peers with disjoint records. Clones repeat every job and lock their own escrow, and a disproved job burns it entirely. Because proofs cannot repeat and endorsers cannot be reused, borrowed reputation is empty, so each extra puppet costs far more than the ballot weight it obtains. canyon vine mesa
